create_EagleDraftWorker: create an EagleDraftWorker instance for speculative token generation with a target model worker
create_EAGLEWorkerV2: create an EAGLEWorkerV2 instance combining draft and target workers for speculative decoding
run_draft_forward: run the draft forward pass to generate speculative token candidates across multiple steps
run_verify: verify draft tokens against the target model and determine which tokens are accepted
run_draft_extend_for_prefill: run draft extend after target prefill to prepare the next speculative decoding step
move_accepted_tokens_to_target_kvcache: move accepted draft tokens from draft KV cache into the target model KV cache
update_weights_from_tensor: update both draft and target model weights from a serialized tensor payload
init_cuda_graphs: capture CUDA graphs for draft and draft extend inference to accelerate execution
